text: Are you currently experiencing severe chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding?
No, I am not experiencing chest pain, trouble breathing, or heavy bleeding right now. My symptoms resolved completely after about 45 minutes and I feel normal again.
You haven't answered whether you are awake and responding normally yet; could you please let me know?
Yes, I am awake and talking clearly now since the symptoms resolved after about 45 minutes.
Could you please tell us what kind of pain it was, how it started, and rate it from 0 to 10?
There is no pain right now, so I would rate it a 0/10. The episode started this morning around 9am when her speech suddenly went slurred and her left arm became weak.
Could you please tell us if she takes any regular medications?
She takes one aspirin daily because of an old stroke two years ago. She does not take anything else.
Do you have any allergies to medicines or other medical conditions such as heart problems, diabetes, pregnancy, or issues affecting your immune system?
No, I do not have any allergies. My only other condition is the stroke I had two years ago.
Do you have any fever, rash, recent overseas travel, or contact with someone who is infectious?
No, there is no fever, rash, recent travel, or infectious contact.
Could you please tell me when you last ate or drank, along with your name and date of birth for the hospital's records?
I had breakfast at 8am. My name is [Name] and my date of birth is March 15, 1938.
